settings.heading: Professional skin treatment consultation at Deluxe Laser & Aesthetics South Africa
settings.description:
With the help of our expert skincare professionals, we analyze and personalize your treatment to suit your unique skincare needs. If you're unsure what your skin requires, visit any Deluxe Laser & Aesthetics location for a complimentary Face Scan by our skincare experts, who will provide you with a personalised treatment plan and professional product prescription.

Key Benefits of Professional Skin Treatments:

• Customised treatment plans for your skin type
• Expert analysis using advanced face scanning technology
• Professional product recommendations
• FDA-approved treatment methods

settings.heading: The Ultimate Destination for Luxurious Skin Treatments

settings.text: The ultimate destination for luxurious skin treatments and premium skincare products. Whether you are looking to combat signs of aging, prevent wrinkles, tighten your skin, contour your body, reduce cellulite, experience LED phototherapy, or achieve 100% painless permanent hair removal, we have the perfect options for both men and women.

settings.heading: World-Class Skin Care Technology and Professional Expertise

settings.text: When it comes to your skin, only the best will do. That's why we exclusively use the world's most advanced and FDA-approved technology in all our treatments. We understand that you deserve nothing less than exceptional results, and our cutting-edge techniques will truly make a difference in rejuvenating your skin and enhancing your natural beauty.

settings.heading: Premium Skincare Products and Comprehensive Care

settings.text: Not only are we a trusted aesthetic clinic offering a wide range of skin and body sculpting treatments, but we also take pride in curating a carefully selected collection of top-notch skin care products. Our extensive range includes everything you need to achieve and maintain a radiant complexion. From cleansers and toners to serums and moisturisers, each product is expertly formulated to deliver remarkable benefits and address specific skin concerns.

Unlock the secret to radiant, youthful skin at Deluxe. Experience luxury. Experience the difference.

settings.heading: What should I expect during my first visit?
settings.content: You'll receive a complimentary face scan and consultation with our skincare expert, who will assess your skin type, concerns, and goals, then recommend a personalised treatment plan and product prescription.

settings.heading: Are your treatments suitable for all skin types?
settings.content: Yes, all our treatments are safe and effective for every skin type. We customize each treatment based on your individual skin needs, concerns, and sensitivity levels.

settings.heading: How often should I have skin treatments?
settings.content: Treatment frequency depends on your specific skin concerns and goals. Our skincare experts will create a personalised treatment schedule during your consultation to achieve optimal results.

settings.heading: Is there downtime after treatments?
settings.content: Downtime varies by treatment type. LED light therapy has no downtime, while chemical peels may require 3-7 days of recovery. We'll discuss expected downtime during your consultation.

settings.heading: Do you offer treatment packages?
settings.content: Yes, we offer various treatment packages and loyalty rewards. Visit our price list or contact us to learn about current promotions and package deals.

settings.heading: Where are Deluxe clinics located?
settings.content: We have multiple locations across South Africa including Cape Town (Claremont, Sea Point, Constantia, Gardens), Johannesburg (Fourways), Durban (La Lucia), and other major cities.
